result: Implemented the bounded Desktop Mission Canvas profile-memory runtime at the packet's exact target path. Generated layout_memoryGet reads and layout_memoryUpdate mutations are consumed through the generated Mission Canvas client; semantic placement preferences, absent contribution IDs, focused semantic target, and exact Workstream authority remain durable memory data. The controller rejects foreign scope/profile/activity/viewport data, stale revisions/cursors, malformed memory, unavailable operations, missing authority, and ambiguous receipts without adopting a fallback, inferring a profile, resolving eligibility, composing a layout, or reserving geometry for an absent contribution.

presentation_contract.surface_kind: Focusa Desktop Mission Canvas Svelte GUI tab
omitted_contribution_reasons: layout memory is semantic preference data and does not render a contribution
absent contribution IDs remain durable memory data and never reserve geometry or render empty chrome
continuity_invariants: CARDINAL-135-SVELTE-001 remains intact: Desktop consumes generated operation results and canonical ResolvedWorkspaceProjection data; it does not become an eligibility, layout, recomposition, or authority owner.

The exact ScopeRef/ProjectRootKey -> WorkstreamId -> ContinuityId -> AttachmentKey -> SessionId/InstanceId -> runtime object -> WorkSurfaceId chain is validated and compared without project-root, tab, or local fallback inference.

Generated transport owns operation metadata, HTTP route/method, DTO validation, permission/concurrency headers, and transport watermarks; the trusted recursive canonical projection renderer remains untouched.

Per-profile memory is keyed by exact Workstream authority plus profile/activity/viewport identity and survives contribution disappearance and return through retained placement and absent-contribution preferences.

PROFILE-001.decision: Generated Core-owned profile selection and exact Workstream transport are integrated; profile memory remains separate semantic persistence and no selector fallback was added.

OPS-009.decision: The exact Workstream/profile/activity/viewport layout-memory read, generated transport, DTO validation, and stale memory watermark are integrated.

OPS-010.decision: The exact Workstream layout-memory mutation, Idempotency-Key/If-Match boundary, Core Receipt/Evidence persistence, and generated transport are integrated.

implementation: The exact profile-memory-controller.ts source exports layoutMemoryGet/layoutMemoryUpdate adapters over generated MissionCanvasClient.layout_memoryGet/layout_memoryUpdate and GeneratedProfileMemoryTransport; no handwritten route or operation registry was introduced.

The controller validates generated ProfileLayoutMemory structure, exact full authority, canonical memory identity, profile/activity/viewport selectors, contribution placement identities/spans/regions, duplicate and placement/absent partitions, timestamps, and revision watermarks before state adoption.

The generated update adapter validates the direct Core RecompositionReceipt, derives only the accepted next semantic memory revision/timestamp, and retains placements and absent contribution IDs. It never receives or constructs layout_tree, eligible_contributions, renderer bindings, or candidate eligibility data.

The controller uses generation cancellation, exact binding keys, immutable state snapshots, optional durable receipt cursor tracking, and conflict/error states. Failed or stale requests retain the last canonical memory and expose the pending input separately instead of falling back or adopting foreign data.

The legacy .svelte.ts import path re-exports the exact .ts runtime source without retaining the partial local controller implementation. The trusted recursive ProjectionLayoutRenderer and generated contract artifacts were not edited.

negative_cases.foreign_workstream_or_attachment: A structurally valid memory from another Workstream or Attachment is rejected before state adoption; update does not call transport for a foreign input and preserves the prior memory.
negative_cases.missing_authority: An absent or malformed Workstream authority is blocked before any generated operation or HTTP call; project_root plus continuity_id is never treated as sufficient scope.
negative_cases.foreign_profile_activity_or_viewport: Memory identity and the exact profile/activity/viewport binding must match; a valid memory for another profile is not selected, repaired, or used as fallback.
negative_cases.stale_revision: The controller maintains per-exact-binding memory watermarks, rejects regressed reads, requires an update to advance exactly one revision from the last canonical memory, and retains the prior memory on stale results.
negative_cases.stale_cursor: Generated transport and the controller reject a regressed or namespace-mismatched Receipt event cursor; no stale Receipt is adopted.
negative_cases.unavailable_capability_or_permission: Generated operation_unavailable and permission-denied transport failures become truthful error/conflict state with no local memory fallback and no invented capability.
negative_cases.malformed_memory_or_receipt: Generated validators plus bounded semantic identity/partition checks reject wrappers, layout trees, malformed placements, duplicate IDs, invalid spans/regions, overlap between placements and absent IDs, invalid timestamps, and malformed/unaccepted Receipts.
negative_cases.ineligible_or_empty_contribution: Absent contribution IDs are retained only as semantic memory. No panel, heading, border, placeholder, reserved geometry, candidate list, eligibility result, or substitute renderer is fabricated.
negative_cases.stale_in_flight_response: A response from an older binding generation cannot overwrite the newer exact profile/activity binding.

acceptance.statement: Contribution disappearance and return restore preferred order without reserved geometry.
acceptance.proof: The runtime test loads memory containing a placement and absent contribution, updates it through generated GET/POST operations, verifies the absent ID and preferred placement remain durable, and asserts no layout_tree or eligible contribution data is created. Core remains the resolver of any returning geometry.

acceptance.statement: A vertical is not a color swap or a hard-coded alternate page.
acceptance.proof: The implementation stores only generated ProfileLayoutMemory semantic preferences scoped by profile/activity/viewport; it contains no profile screen inventory, local eligibility, alternate page, palette, or layout resolver.

acceptance.statement: Per-profile layout memory survives contribution disappearance and return.
acceptance.proof: Exact profile/activity/viewport memory is retained across load/update, with absent contribution IDs and preferred placement order preserved. Foreign, stale, malformed, unavailable, and missing-authority cases fail closed.

acceptance.statement: Preserves CARDINAL-135-SVELTE-001, exact Workstream authority, generated transport, trusted renderer ownership, recursive canonical projection rendering, and fail-closed mismatches.
acceptance.proof: The required npm test passes the real Vite-loaded controller and generated HTTP client adapter; transport paths/headers and direct DTO/Receipt shapes are asserted, while the existing recursive renderer and generated contracts remain unchanged.

deferred_repository_observation: The central executable graph, generated task packets/index, parallel plan, orchestration scripts, operation registry, OpenAPI, generated client, generated validators, and trusted recursive projection renderer were not edited. Cargo was not run.
